description: Autonomous test discovery workflow - scans entire codebase, identifies all modules, functions, classes, and entry points that require test coverage, maps dependencies, and generates test plan.
author: ProjectZeroDays (All-Knowing Deity)

steps.description: Scan entire repository for all Python, JavaScript, Kotlin, and configuration files
steps.action: Scan all source files, identify public APIs, classes, functions, entry points, and API endpoints

steps.description: Analyze existing test coverage, identify untested code paths, missing test coverage, and high-risk areas
steps.action: Map existing tests to source files, identify gaps in test coverage, prioritize high-risk untested code

steps.description: Create comprehensive test plan covering unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, edge cases, boundary conditions, and error scenarios
steps.action: Generate detailed test plan with test cases, expected inputs, expected outputs, and edge cases for every function and class
